title: Cupid
synopsis: A mysterious man sets out to eliminate the sources of aggression and noise disturbing a city's peace. But his ruthless attempts to restore silence lead to increasingly unsettling consequences.

audienceReactions.quote: No but this is genuinely amazing — I can't even bring myself to call it AI slop.

audienceReactions.quote: Plenty of references here. I rewatched it frame by frame, read everything. Laughed so hard. Great work.
